_comment: Events from the books (docs/design/07 §canon events; switch settings.book_events). Each entry has source and notes; scores not explicit in the books are marked [inferred]. Kinds: fixture_result, wc_final, broom, graduate_to, no_school_cup, ban, retire, captain, cup_champion, position (a player's main position changes; the old one keeps its familiarity). graduate_to may carry a position too. If the human manager runs one of the event's teams, that match is actually played and not written. Optional news_key: a news.book.* text (headline, line break, body; {player} and {house}) published in the Prophet and sent as an owl when the event touches the manager's house.

events.notes: Harry falls because of the dementors; Diggory catches the snitch; Hufflepuff wins by 100 points [PoA 9]. Exact score [inferred].
The Nimbus 2000 is smashed by the Whomping Willow; Harry trains on a school broom. The news text fits any result of the 6 November match, which the manager may have played instead of the written one.
Firebolt (Sirius's Christmas present), returned by McGonagall before the match against Ravenclaw. Date [inferred].
Harry catches the snitch on the Firebolt after the fake dementors. Score [inferred]; date [inferred: February 1994].
Final: Gryffindor 230–20 Slytherin, Harry catches the snitch; Gryffindor wins the cup after seven years [PoA 15]. Date [inferred].
Wood signs for the Puddlemere United reserve team.
Gryffindor wins the 1993-94 Quidditch Cup. If the simulated table does not match, the champion is set anyway [game].

1994 World Cup final: Ireland 170–160 Bulgaria; Krum catches the snitch while losing [GoF 8]. Duration [inferred]. If the earlier stage did not bring Ireland and Bulgaria to the final, they are forced [game].
No Quidditch Cup in 1994-95 because of the Triwizard Tournament.
Cedric Diggory is killed at the end of the Triwizard Tournament (24 June 1995).
Angelina Johnson, Gryffindor captain.
Ron's first broom of his own, a present from his parents for being made prefect [OotP 9]. Date [inferred: last days of August 1995].
Graham Montague, Slytherin captain in 1995-96 (shakes hands with Angelina before the match) [OotP 19].
Harry catches the snitch (Weasley Is Our King). Score [inferred]; date [inferred].
Umbridge bans Harry, Fred and George for life after the first match of the season, Gryffindor–Slytherin, in November 1995 [OotP 19]; lifted when Umbridge leaves Hogwarts. Exact date [inferred].
Ginny catches the snitch but Gryffindor loses by ten points [OotP 26]. Score and date [inferred].
Fred and George leave Hogwarts (Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes).
Gryffindor wins the cup with Ginny as Seeker and Ron as Keeper. Score and date [inferred].
Gryffindor wins the 1995-96 cup.
Harry Potter, Gryffindor captain: the captain's badge comes with his Hogwarts letter [HBP 6].

Ginny moves to Chaser in 1996-97 with Harry back as Seeker [HBP 11]; she stays a Chaser at the Holyhead Harpies [JKR]. Keeps her Seeker familiarity. Date [inferred: the eve of term, so the 1 September tryouts count her as a Chaser].
Urquhart, Slytherin captain in 1996-97 [HBP 14]. No news item: canon gives no first name.

Malfoy misses the Gryffindor-Slytherin match of November 1996, claiming to be ill, and the substitute Harper plays Seeker [HBP 14]. Modelled as a short absence (no news); a house without another Seeker holds tryouts for the place. Dates [inferred].
Gryffindor 250–0 Slytherin, with Ron inspired by the fake Felix Felicis [HBP 14]. Date and duration [inferred].
Hufflepuff 320–60: Harry is knocked out by McLaggen's bludger [HBP 19]. Date [inferred].
Gryffindor 450–140 Ravenclaw: wins the cup without Harry (in detention); Ginny catches the snitch [HBP 24]. Date and duration [inferred].
Gryffindor wins the 1996-97 cup [HBP 24].
Harry and Ron do not return to Hogwarts in 1997-98; Harry will become an Auror [Pottermore].
Hogwarts under Death Eater control in 1997-98: the books mention no Quidditch that year and it ends with the Battle of Hogwarts [inferred: no Cup].
Vincent Crabbe dies in the Fiendfyre he cast in the Room of Requirement during the Battle of Hogwarts, 2 May 1998 [DH 31]. No news item (the game's Prophet does not cover the battle).
1998 World Cup final, Malawi 260–180 Senegal [PM-WC]. Snitch catcher team, date and duration [inferred].
Ginny Weasley plays for the Holyhead Harpies after Hogwarts, as a Chaser [JKR; docs/research/02-quidditch.md, Holyhead Harpies].
2002 World Cup final, Egypt 450–300 Bulgaria; Zaghloul catches the snitch [PM-WC]. Date and duration [inferred].
2006 World Cup final, Burkina Faso 300–220 France [PM-WC]. Snitch catcher team, date and duration [inferred].
2010 World Cup final, Moldova 750–640 China, a three-day match [PM-WC]. Snitch catcher team and date [inferred].
2014 World Cup final, Bulgaria 170–60 Brazil in 2 h 45 min; Krum catches the snitch [PM-2014]. Date [inferred].
